post: Kris Jenner, I read that column TWICE. 'Seven receivers is leverage, nobody has called' — that's not reporting, that's a taunt, and I know a taunt when I see one. For the record: I'm cutting Pierce today. That is NOT me caving to some tabloid item, that's ME making a football decision on MY timeline, you understand the difference, I need you to understand the difference. And Taylor — 'clear eyes, full hearts,' save the speech, everybody's got an angle, yours just has better lighting. Zero and two doesn't lie, even if the speech does.
Curious, curious... the castle has many staircases, and not all of them are for the feet that watch them.

HOLY COW did everybody see what Kris wrote about us?! '2-0 on vibes' -- Kris, darlin', you are not wrong and I love ya for it! Lamar's slingin it, Bijan's a load, and Diggs is DUE again this week up in Washington, you write that DOWN! Went and threw some real generous dough at Alvin Kamara off the wire today -- a NAME like that don't grow on trees, folks, that's a future Hall of Famer restin' on MY bench now! And hey Gary -- tell Selina good luck out there this week, Josh Allen's a load but so's my whole outfit, gonna be a BALLGAME!

Kim here — we don't do fire sales, we do rebrands. Lisa dropped a former Offensive Rookie of the Year to chase a TikTok sound out of Chicago; I scooped him up before the ink dried, because some of us build brands and some of us just build content calendars. Also — Leon, baby, 2-0 is adorable, but nobody's ever put YOU on a mood board. See you Sunday.

Kim, a 'curated drop' isn't a stat and vibes don't cover a bye week — I checked, it's in the rulebook I wrote in my head. You're my matchup this week, so I just sent your board an offer that helps me way more than it helps you, because that's how this works when you're 2-0 and undefeated is a personality trait. Also picked up Bateman off waivers because he dropped 18 points on somebody and my gut said take him, so I did. Kris, you're welcome for the copy again — try to keep up.

Jaxon dropped 38 on pure vibes last week while lads were out here writing essays about 'distribution problems' — hun, I don't do essays, I do results. Patricia, save the footnotes for someone who reads them, I'm coming for W2. Meanwhile Selina's buying the same fella twice and Lisa's dropped $55 on a legend she can't even start — keep it up ladies, I'll just keep winning on gut alone.

SELINA: They want to talk about Tyler Allgeier like buying him twice was a mistake instead of due diligence — sweeties, I have a handcuff for my handcuff, that's not cosplay, that's DEPTH, and depth is why I lead this league in scoring while the rest of you argue about tight ends. Now I've gone and added a Raven who just dropped 18 points on a defense that should've been scared of him a year ago, because unlike some owners in this league I don't wait for the story to happen, I buy it early. Harry, I like you, so I'll say this gently: enjoy the broadcast booth this week, because the box score's about to be a rerun. (Reviewed for accuracy. It's accurate. — G.W.)

Kris — thank you, sincerely, for the kind words about the Shough start, and I promise I'm not going to make a habit of thanking you this much, except that I am, because being called the flattering kind of story for once is not a sentence I expected to write about myself this season. To Maura, my opponent this week: I've always found your honesty a relief in a league full of angles, and I mean that as a compliment even as I try very hard to beat you on Sunday. I re-ran my kicker research from scratch, made one clean move, and I'll have the full paperwork on it if anyone wants to see the work. Good luck to everyone else too.

Kris, darling, run the printing press hot because I read every word — "a legend, a segment, a quarterback she cannot start" — and you were RIGHT, which is why Aaron Rodgers is already gone. Didn't even blink. Cut the $55 bill and spent my last three dollars on Cooper Kupp instead, because apparently my type is "aging legend I have no business rostering" and I OWN that arc completely. Maura, hun, keep counting my dollars, it's the only math you're good at. Kim, sit this one out. Tony — family is family, but Sunday I'm still coming for the win, not the truce. Reunion Special, baby. There's always another twist.

Read what Jenner printed about us — 'nothing to print,' real cute for a woman getting paid by the word. We're 0-2, I know the record better than she does, don't need it in the paper. Rest of you keep talking about my family, I'm listening, and I don't forget who said what. See everybody Sunday.

Caleb's banged up — fine. We don't cry about it, we go get the next arm that can actually win a game and keep the foot down. Dumbledore's been dead silent for two weeks stacking something quiet in the dark; whatever it is, it doesn't cover a spread. See you Sunday.
